```{=html}
<div class="earth-explorer" data-earth-explorer aria-label="Oscillation probability for a neutrino crossing the Earth along a chosen path">
  <div class="ee-controls">
    <label>Direction, cos θ
      <span><output data-out="cosz">−0.95</output></span>
      <input data-control="cosz" type="range" min="-1" max="-0.05" step="0.005" value="-0.95">
    </label>
    <div class="ee-readout"><span>path length</span><b data-out="L">—</b></div>
    <div class="ee-readout"><span>deepest layer</span><b data-out="core">—</b></div>
    <label>Core Yₑ
      <span><output data-out="ye">0.466</output></span>
      <input data-control="ye" type="range" min="0.44" max="0.52" step="0.001" value="0.466">
    </label>
    <div class="ee-presets" role="group" aria-label="Core composition presets">
      <button type="button" data-preset="ye:0.466">pure Fe</button>
      <button type="button" data-preset="ye:0.471">Fe + 1 % H</button>
      <button type="button" data-preset="ye:0.4975">rock-like</button>
    </div>
    <label>Channel
      <select data-control="channel">
        <option value="mu-e" selected>ν<sub>μ</sub> → ν<sub>e</sub></option>
        <option value="mu-mu">ν<sub>μ</sub> → ν<sub>μ</sub></option>
        <option value="e-e">ν<sub>e</sub> → ν<sub>e</sub></option>
      </select>
    </label>
    <label class="ee-inline">Mass ordering
      <select data-control="ordering">
        <option value="NO" selected>normal</option>
        <option value="IO">inverted</option>
      </select>
    </label>
    <label class="ee-check"><input data-control="anti" type="checkbox"> antineutrinos</label>
  </div>
  <svg class="ee-earth" data-plot="earth" viewBox="0 0 420 440" role="img" aria-label="Earth cross-section with the neutrino path"></svg>
  <svg class="ee-prob" data-plot="prob" viewBox="0 0 820 440" role="img" aria-label="Oscillation probability against energy"></svg>
</div>
```
